description: ADR-0032 Phase 0 pilot: the critical seeded faults of core, robust, curve, io and topo (the guards the audit of 2026-10-20 added among them), conventional mutants, and one example each of the invalid and inconclusive outcomes. The former equivalent example, EQUIV-PRUNE, claimed a weaker tie rule than Project's contract and is now REL-PRUNE, killed by an exact tie.

mutants.operator: domain: filtered-predicate fallback skipped
mutants.contract: ADR-0002: Orient2D is exact; a filter failure must fall back to the adaptive stages
mutants.diagnostic: robust: the orientation grid of Kettner et al. is decided exactly

mutants.operator: domain: orientation sign reversed
mutants.contract: ADR-0002: Orient2D's sign is that of the determinant
diagnostic: robust: predicates agree with exact integer arithmetic on random points

mutants.operator: domain: stale generation accepted
mutants.contract: ADR-0004: a handle to a removed entity is stale and detected
mutants.find:
return index < m_Generations.size() && m_Alive[index] &&
               m_Generations[index] == h.GetGeneration();
mutants.diagnostic: core: generation tables detect stale handles

mutants.operator: relational: closed lower bound made open
mutants.contract: ADR-0001/ADR-0028: intervals are closed; a value on the boundary is contained
diagnostic: core: intervals are closed and may be empty

mutants.operator: domain: a checker finding suppressed
mutants.contract: ADR-0016 (standing in for ADR-0018's checker): a knot inside the domain repeated more than the degree is rejected
mutants.diagnostic: curve: MakeBSplineCurve validates data from outside the kernel

mutants.operator: relational: <= to < at the frame allowance
mutants.contract: ADR-0028: FrameAllowance admits a frame whose error equals it

mutants.operator: arithmetic: + to - in the Cox-de Boor recurrence
mutants.contract: B-spline basis functions (The NURBS Book, A2.2)

mutants.operator: relational: >= to > in the span search
mutants.contract: FindSpan keeps knots[low] <= t < knots[high] (A2.1)

mutants.operator: relational: > to >= in best-first pruning
mutants.contract: Project(BSplineCurve): the global closest point, the smaller parameter on equal distance (ADR-0007), so a segment whose bound equals the best distance is still searched
mutants.diagnostic: curve: a projection tie across segments goes to the smaller parameter

mutants.operator: domain: a repeated chunk accepted
mutants.contract: ADR-0012: each of POLI, CRVS, PCRV and SRFS appears exactly once; a second would replace what the first decoded
mutants.diagnostic: io: an archive missing a chunk, cut at a chunk boundary or repeating one is refused

mutants.operator: domain: a missing chunk accepted
mutants.contract: ADR-0012: an archive cut after a complete chunk is refused, not read as empty geometry
mutants.diagnostic: io: an archive missing a chunk, cut at a chunk boundary or repeating one is refused

mutants.operator: domain: a record newer than the file's version accepted
mutants.contract: ADR-0012: a format version reads only the records it has
mutants.diagnostic: io: a record newer than the file's format version is refused

mutants.operator: domain: a checker finding suppressed
mutants.contract: ADR-0018/ADR-0025: S12, a face's surface in the pool must hold geometry
mutants.diagnostic: topo: S12 MissingGeometry: an empty curve, pcurve or surface in the pool

mutants.operator: domain: an empty surface admitted to the pool
mutants.contract: ADR-0027: the builder refuses an empty surface
mutants.diagnostic: topo: the geometry pools refuse empty geometry and a spent builder

mutants.operator: domain: faces joined only in the radial anchor's shell
mutants.contract: ADR-0018: S15, the faces of every shell around a shared edge are edge-connected, whichever shell holds the anchor
mutants.diagnostic: topo: S15: an edge shared by two shells connects the faces of each, whichever holds its anchor

mutants.operator: domain: the edit guard skipped
mutants.contract: ADR-0005: no page is shared while an edit callback holds a reference into it
mutants.diagnostic: core: taking an arena page inside its edit callback is reported

mutants.operator: domain: the trimmed-curve conversion skipped
mutants.contract: ADR-0003: ToBSpline through the wrapper reaches a trimmed curve's exact form
mutants.replace: if (const auto* trimmed = curve.Target<TrimmedCurve>(); false && trimmed != nullptr) {
mutants.diagnostic: curve: a trimmed curve converts through the erased wrapper over any subrange

mutants.operator: domain: weights outside the supported range accepted
mutants.contract: ADR-0006: MakeBSplineCurve refuses weights outside [MinWeight, MaxWeight]
mutants.diagnostic: curve: weights outside the supported range are refused, and a common scale changes nothing

mutants.operator: demonstration: a mutant that does not build
mutants.contract: Reporting: a build failure is Invalid, not a kill

mutants.operator: demonstration: a mutant that never terminates
mutants.contract: Reporting: a timeout is Inconclusive, not a kill
